excerpt: In Statistical Abstract of the United States: 1982-83, Table No. 648 (page 386), total employed workers were 99,303 thousand in 1980 and 100,397 thousand in 1981; Operatives totaled 14,096 thousand in 1980 (10,565 thousand except transport + 3,531 thousand transport) and 14,016 thousand in 1981, down from 14,782 thousand in 1979; Farm workers numbered 2,741 thousand in 1980.
limitation: Shows benchmark years 1960, 1970, 1975, 1979, 1980, and 1981 (omitting 1974), and notes that beginning 1975 occupational classifications are not strictly comparable with prior years due to reclassification.

coverage: Council of Economic Advisers, Economic Report of the President (February 1982), Table B-29: Noninstitutional population and the labor force, 1929-81 (CPS industry classification: Agriculture vs. Nonagricultural employment, thousands).
excerpt: In Economic Report of the President (February 1982), Table B-29, total civilian employment rose from 86,794 thousand in 1974 to 99,303 thousand in 1980, while agricultural industry employment declined modestly from 3,515 thousand (4.05% of total civilian employment) in 1974 to 3,364 thousand (3.39%) in 1980.
limitation: Measures employment by industry (Agriculture, which includes non-farm occupations employed in agricultural enterprises) rather than by occupational category (Farm workers), yielding higher headcounts than Bell's occupational baseline of 3.0 million in 1974.

coverage: U.S. Bureau of the Census, Statistical Abstract of the United States: 1982-83 (103rd edition), Section 13, Table No. 648 (p. 386), compiling U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment and Earnings annual averages for 1960, 1970, 1975, 1979, 1980, and 1981.
excerpt: In 1980, total employed civilians (16+) were 99,303 thousand: Clerical workers 18,473 thousand (18.6%), Professional and technical 15,968 thousand (16.1%), Operatives except transport 10,565 thousand (10.6%) plus Transport equipment operatives 3,531 thousand (3.6%) totaling 14,096 thousand (14.2%), Service workers 13,228 thousand (13.3%), and Craft and kindred workers 12,787 thousand (12.9%).
limitation: Table headnote states that beginning 1975, figures are not strictly comparable with prior years due to reclassification of occupations; 1980 percentage shares are computed directly from the reported 1980 totals (Table 648 prints percent distribution columns for 1970, 1975, and 1981).

coverage: ERIC bibliographic record EJ265494 for Max L. Carey and Kevin Kasunic, 'Evaluating the 1980 Projections of Occupational Employment', Monthly Labor Review, Vol. 105, No. 7, July 1982, pp. 22-30.
excerpt: BLS's 1980 occupational projections were on target for professional and service occupations and fairly accurate for clerical occupations, but significantly off the mark for operative occupations.
limitation: ERIC record provides the official abstract of the July 1982 Monthly Labor Review evaluation rather than the full numerical tables; exact 1980 counts are cross-checked against Census Statistical Abstract Table 648.

coverage: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Public Data API v2, Current Population Survey (CPS) monthly series LNU02032212 (Production, transportation, and material moving occupations), LNU02032213 (Production occupations), LNU02032214 (Transportation and material moving occupations), LNU02000000 (Total employed), and CES series CEU3000000001 (Manufacturing all employees), 2003-2025.
excerpt: Within Production, transportation, and material moving occupations (LNU02032212), Production occupations (LNU02032213) fell from 53.8% in 2003 to 39.9% in 2025, while Transportation and material moving occupations (LNU02032214) rose from 46.2% to 60.1%.
limitation: Modern SOC classification (2003-2025) is not strictly identical to the 1968 CPS 'operatives' definition, and LNU02032213 includes both manufacturing and non-manufacturing production workers (providing an upper bound on factory workers within the combined semi-skilled group).

coverage: Marc Levinson, 'Job Creation in the Manufacturing Revival', Congressional Research Service (CRS) Report R41898, updated July 19, 2019, analyzing BLS CPS Table 17 and May 2018 OEWS data on U.S. manufacturing occupational composition and temporary employment services.
excerpt: Only two in five manufacturing employees are directly involved in making things (down nearly 4 percentage points since 2000), while 916,847 people in typical manufacturing production occupations worked for employment services firms in May 2018 and are classified outside manufacturing.
limitation: Data in this report extend through 2018-2019; it highlights a classification caveat that temporary staffing agency workers performing factory production tasks are counted in professional and business services rather than manufacturing.

coverage: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）《劳工统计手册》（Bulletin 2175，1983年12月）表16：1958–1982年按主要职业类别划分的美国平民就业人数（千人）与百分比分布（含1958、1968、1980年全口径年度均值）。
limitation: 该序列已按1980年人口普查人口控制数进行事后修订（1980年总就业99,303千人、专业与技术15,968千人），与1980年当年未修订初值存在约2%总量差异；FRASER全文为OCR转录文本，个别表格换页处存在列折行。

coverage: 美国教育部ERIC数据库收录的BLS官方回溯评估论文摘要：Max L. Carey & Kevin Kasunic，《评估1980年职业就业预测》（Monthly Labor Review，1982年7月，第105卷第7期，第22-30页）。
excerpt: BLS对1980年职业就业预测的事后评估指出，BLS对专业职业（professional）和服务职业（service）的1980年预测准确命中目标（on target），对农业、工艺、文职和销售职业较为准确，而对管理行政、非农体力劳动与操作工职业偏差较大。
limitation: ERIC条目仅提供经编目核验的官方论文题录与摘要，未附完整表格明细；具体1968-1980年分职业人数与占比需与BLS Bulletin 2175和Bulletin 2096原始统计表互证。

coverage: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）《当前人口调查劳动力统计数据手册（第一卷）》（Bulletin 2096，1982年9月）表B-18：1972–1981年按职业、性别、年龄划分的年度平均就业人数（含1980年全年龄段及分职业核验数据）。
excerpt: Table B-18独立核验1980年16岁及以上美国平民总就业为99,303千人，白领51,882千人，其中专业与技术职业15,968千人（占16.08%），文职18,473千人，管理与行政11,138千人，服务职业13,228千人。
limitation: 表B-18起始年份为1972年，不包含1958年与1968年基期数值，主要用于交叉核验1980年终点就业人数与结构占比，并同样采用1980年人口普查修订口径。

coverage: 美国工会选民在2024年总统大选中的政治影响力、党派倾向，以及1983-2023年BLS工会化率与公私部门分化
excerpt: 2024年美国总统大选中两党仍竞相争取工会选民，工会工人在多个关键摇摆州仍是决定白宫归属的关键选民群体；同时1983-2023年美国整体工会化率从20.1%降至10.0%（公共部门32.5% vs 私营部门6.0%）。
limitation: 仅反映2023-2024年横截面民调与1983-2023年BLS数据，不含1973-1982年数据，且衡量的是选举政治关注度与选民倾向而非直接立法成功率。

coverage: 1980-2016年美国联邦选举PAC与外部竞选开支趋势（含劳工工会PAC开支占比与党派偏好）
excerpt: 1980-2016年间，劳工组织始终偏好支持民主党候选人，且自2008年以来越来越多地动用独立外部开支和通讯费用支持候选人；但与此同时，劳工在所有PAC委员会总开支中的占比在1980-2016年间持平或下降。
limitation: 数据止于2016年联邦选举周期，未覆盖州与地方政治游说，且竞选资金占比仅是政治影响力的维度之一。

coverage: 美国国会研究局（CRS）关于美国工会会员长期趋势（1954-2003年，精确覆盖贝尔1973年后约30年窗口）与公私部门分化、工会工资溢价的分析
excerpt: 美国工会会员总数于1979年达峰（约2100万），至2003年降至约1580万（占就业人口11.5%）；2003年公共部门工会化率仍高达37.2%，而私营部门跌至7.2%；多数研究发现工会成员仍享有10%-30%的工资溢价。
limitation: 报告发表于2004年8月，数据截至2003年，主要聚焦会员规模、公私部门结构与工资溢价，未直接量化国会游说胜率。

coverage: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）2023年工会成员官方年度新闻稿（含1983-2023年趋势、公私部门工会化率与中位周薪对比）
excerpt: 2023年美国工会化率为10.0%，工会会员总数为1440万（低于1983年的20.1%和1770万）；公共部门工会化率（32.5%）仍是私营部门（6.0%）的五倍以上，非工会成员中位周薪为工会成员的86%（1090美元对1263美元）。
limitation: BLS可比CPS系列始于1983年，不含1973-1982年；该统计仅反映会员人数、行业密度与周薪，不直接衡量政治影响力。

coverage: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）《劳动力中的女性数据手册（2009版）》表9：1970-2008年25-64岁平民劳动力按受教育程度分布（基于3月CPS）
excerpt: 1980年美国25-64岁平民劳动力总计7801万人，其中不足4年高中占20.6%，4年高中（无大学）占39.8%，1-3年大学占17.6%，4年及以上大学占22.0%——即至少完成4年高中教育者占比达79.4%（约6191万人）。
limitation: 口径为25-64岁平民劳动力而非25岁及以上（未含65岁及以上劳动力），且未单独拆分小学不足8年子类。

coverage: BLS《月度劳工评论》1982年4月刊（Anne McDougall Young）：1980年3月与1981年3月美国25-64岁劳动力受教育程度绝对人数与比例
excerpt: 经1980年人口普查修订后，1980年3月美国25-64岁平民劳动力男性4541.7万、女性3259.3万（合计7801.0万），其中不足4年高中者男性1010.3万、女性599.9万（合计1610.2万），完成4年高中及以上者约6190.8万人（79.4%）。
limitation: 表1统计口径为25-64岁劳动力，且将小学与高中未毕业合并为“Less than 4 years of high school”，未单独列示不足8年人数。

coverage: BLS特别劳动力报告第240号（1981年1月，重印自1980年7月MLR，ERIC ED197092）：1979年3月16岁及以上美国劳动力按细化受教育年限（含小学不足5年、5-7年）分布
excerpt: 1979年3月美国16岁及以上平民劳动力总计10157.9万人，其中受教育不足5年者137.2万人、5至7年者310.8万人，合计受教育不足8年者已降至448.0万人（占全体劳动力4.4%）。
limitation: 数据为1979年3月（1980年前一年）且表B口径为16岁及以上全体劳动力，25岁及以上劳动力中不足8年者人数会略低于448万；PDF系历史扫描件OCR，个别标点有轻微识别噪点。

coverage: BLS第2191号公报（1984年4月，ERIC ED251688）：1940-1983年美国18-64岁平民劳动力受教育程度历史序列及1983年3月细化小学年限分布
excerpt: 1980年3月美国18-64岁平民劳动力中，小学不足5年占1.1%、5至8年占6.5%（即8年及以下合计仅7.6%）；至1983年3月全体16岁及以上平民劳动力中，小学不足5年占1.1%、5至7年占2.4%（不足8年合计仅3.5%）。
limitation: 表B-1为18-64岁口径且合并了5-8年，表B-4为1983年3月16岁及以上口径；PDF为历史扫描件OCR（表B-1中1980年年份列被OCR误识为1993）。

coverage: U.S. Census Bureau CPS Historical Time Series Table A-1: Years of School Completed by People 25 Years and Over, 1940-2025 (including 1968 and 1980 counts in thousands)
excerpt: Table A-1 shows that in 1980, out of 130,000 thousand people 25 years and over, 19,380 thousand had completed 1 to 3 years of college (14.9%) and 22,190 thousand had completed 4 years of college or more (17.0%).
limitation: Numbers are in thousands for the noninstitutionalized population (excluding military in barracks) and rounded in the 2025 historical release; prior to 1992 categories measured years of school completed rather than formal degrees.

coverage: NCES Digest of Education Statistics 2023 Table 104.10: Rates of high school completion and bachelor's degree attainment among persons age 25 and over, 1910-2023
excerpt: In 1980, 17.0 percent of persons age 25 and over had completed 4 or more years of college (up from 11.0 percent in 1970 and 7.7 percent in 1960), while 68.6 percent had completed high school or higher.
limitation: Table 104.10 reports percentages (not headcounts) and does not separate 1 to 3 years of college; data prior to 1992 cover persons with 4 or more years of college even if they did not complete a degree.

coverage: U.S. Census Bureau historical overview of the U.S. foreign-born population from 1850 to 2024
excerpt: Starting in 1920, the foreign-born share began to consistently decline to a historic low of 4.7% in 1970, before climbing after the 1965 immigration reforms to 50.2 million (14.8% of the total U.S. population) in 2024.
limitation: Covers the total U.S. foreign-born population rather than specifically blue-collar workers or second-generation (foreign/mixed parentage) workers.

coverage: Migration Policy Institute (MPI) tabulation of U.S. Census Bureau 2024 ACS and 1970-2024 decennial/CPS data on immigrant share of U.S. civilian labor force and first- plus second-generation population
excerpt: Immigrants constituted more than 18 percent (32.2 million) of the U.S. civilian labor force in 2024, more than tripling since 1970 (~5%), while immigrants and their U.S.-born children reached 97.2 million (29 percent of the U.S. population) in 2024.
limitation: Reports national civilian labor force share and combined first- and second-generation share of total noninstitutionalized population rather than a single combined first-plus-second-generation blue-collar occupation series.

coverage: Harvard Joint Center for Housing Studies (JCHS) research brief on foreign-born workers in U.S. construction trades (2013-2025)
excerpt: Over a third of construction trades workers were foreign-born in 2024, compared with nearly a fifth of the overall labor force, with particularly disproportionate growth in lower-wage trades; net international migration fell sharply in 2025.
limitation: Focuses on construction trades (a major blue-collar segment) and first-generation foreign-born workers only (excluding second-generation U.S.-born children of immigrants), so total foreign-stock share in construction is even higher.

coverage: 美国公立中小学教师平均年薪（名义美元与2007-08不变美元），1959-60至1982-83学年，美国教育部国家教育统计中心（NCES）
excerpt: 美国公立中小学教师不变美元（2007-08美元）平均年薪在1960年代从1959-60学年的35,989美元稳步升至1969-70学年的48,343美元，并在1972-73学年见顶于50,314美元；随后在1970年代回落至1979-80学年的43,549美元与1980-81学年的43,120美元。
limitation: 仅覆盖公立中小学教师，不直接涵盖医生或工程师；数据按学年统计并采用CPI平减为2007-08不变美元。

coverage: 美国大学及研究生/专业学位工资溢价与长期工资结构变化，1915-2005年，NBER Working Paper 13568（Goldin & Katz）
excerpt: 美国大学工资溢价（含本科及研究生/专业学位相对高中学历的对数工资差）在1960-70年年均上升0.69个百分点，但在1970-80年转为年均下降0.74个百分点；1980-90年又强劲反弹至年均+1.51个百分点。
limitation: 以大学及专业学位群体作为专业人士整体收入代理指标，并非单独按工程师、医生、教师分列；且1970年代溢价下降亦受婴儿潮毕业生供给激增与滞胀影响，不限于政府预算约束。

coverage: 美国私营非管理层工人实际平均时薪与1970年代高通胀期名义/实际工资背离，1973-2018年，皮尤研究中心（引用BLS数据）
excerpt: 1970年代及1980年代初高通胀期间名义平均工资常年同比上涨7%至9%，但经通胀调整后的实际平均时薪早在1973年1月（4.03美元，折合2018年23.68美元）即达历史峰值，此后数十年几乎停滞。
limitation: 覆盖对象为私营部门非管理层生产与非监督工人而非特定专业人士，主要用于界定1970年代名义收入与实际收入口径差异及宏观停滞背景。

coverage: 2024年美国专业人士工会成员规模、工会化率及分职业增长情况，AFL-CIO专业雇员部（引用BLS年度工会报告）
excerpt: 根据2024年BLS年度工会报告，美国加入工会的专业人士接近650万人（较2023年增加3.2万人），占近6,280万专业劳动力中的10.3%，且在联邦和地方政府、建筑师/工程师/科学家、律师、注册护士及计算机等职业均有增长。
limitation: 发布方为工会联合会下属机构（数据引自BLS）；10.3%的专业人士工会密度本身仍远低于工业时代峰值，且文中亦指出美国劳动法障碍限制了私营专业人士建会。

coverage: 美国职业许可制度覆盖率长期变化（1950年代至2023年）与BLS职业许可数据，明尼阿波利斯联邦储备银行
excerpt: 美国受州政府职业许可约束的劳动力比例已从1950年代的仅5%扩大到2023年的远超20%，在注册护士、中小学教师等专业职业中尤为显著。
limitation: 职业许可涵盖部分非专业服务业（如美发师），并非全部为专业人士，也不能等同于自主结社或集体谈判工会。

coverage: 美国整体、私营部门、公共部门及分职业（含建筑与工程）工会密度长期演变（1954-2022年），美国国会研究服务局（CRS R47596）
excerpt: 2022年美国整体工会化率降至10.1%（较1954年33.5%峰值下降23.4个百分点）；私营非铁路航空部门仅5.7%，公共部门为33.2%；建筑与工程职业私营部门工会化率由1984-86年的5.9%显著降至2020-22年的2.9%。
limitation: CRS职业分组图对比起点为1984-86年而非1973年，且仅衡量工会集体谈判维度，不涵盖非工会专业协会或职业许可制度。

coverage: 美国医学会（AMA）医生会员占比长期变动（1950年代初至2011年），CMAJ（收录于NIH PMC3153537）
excerpt: 1950年代初约75%的美国医生是美国医学会（AMA）会员，但此后数十年持续下降，至2011年总会员跌破21.6万，扣除医学生与住院医后仅约15%的执业美国医生属于AMA。
limitation: 数据截至2011年且仅针对全国性综合医学会（AMA），未统计各专科医学会会员的替代增长，但直接反驳了传统全国性专业协会持续扩张的单一图景。

coverage: U.S. BLS Current Population Survey (FRED LNS11000002): 1970, 1973, 2000, 2024, 2025 monthly civilian labor force level for women (16+).
limitation: Live FRED CSV export without fixed article publication date; represents absolute female labor force level and must be paired with total civilian labor force (CLF16OV) to compute women's share.

coverage: U.S. BLS Current Population Survey (FRED CLF16OV): 1970, 1973, 2000, 2024, 2025 monthly total civilian labor force level (16+).
limitation: Live FRED CSV export without fixed article publication date; paired with LNS11000002, shows women's share of the U.S. civilian labor force rose from 38.92% (1973 annual avg) to 47.07% (2024) and 47.02% (2025, 11-month avg excluding Oct 2025).

coverage: Congressional Research Service (CRS) Report RL32553, Union Membership Trends in the United States (1970-2003).
excerpt: Union membership in the United States has declined significantly in recent decades. The number of union members peaked in 1979 at an estimated 21.0 million. In 2003, an estimated 15.8 million workers were union members.
limitation: Covers historical series through 2003; reflects aggregate union membership trends without isolating gender as a causal factor.

coverage: Congressional Research Service (CRS) Report R47596, A Brief Examination of Union Membership Data (through 2022).
excerpt: In 2022, 10.1% of all employed wage and salary workers were members of unions. In the private sector, union density was 5.7% for workers who were not employed in the airline or railroad industries. The union density for public-sector workers was 33.2%.
limitation: Latest observation year in report is 2022; highlights stark divergence between private-sector (5.7% non-airline/rail) and public-sector (33.2%) union density.

coverage: National Women's Law Center (NWLC) Fact Sheet (Sept 2026), citing Feb 18, 2026 BLS Table 1 (2005-2025) and Aug 2026 Gallup polling on women and unions.
excerpt: Overall, women make up almost half of union members (46.0%),6 and in August 2026, about 3 in 4 women (74%) and people of color (76%) approve of unions,7 signaling just how desirable union membership is. ... Membership rates for women, overall, have gone from 11.3% in 2005 to 9.6% in 2025.
limitation: Advocacy research fact sheet summarizing official BLS 2025 CPS union data and Gallup polling; directly challenges Bell's causal assumption that women's workforce characteristics explain union recruiting difficulties.

coverage: U.S. BLS Current Employment Statistics via FRED series USGOVT (All Employees: Government, civilian nonfarm, 1968 and 1980 monthly).
limitation: Live FRED CSV export without fixed article publication date; seasonally adjusted revised BLS CES series (excludes active-duty military); 1980 annual average of 16.38 million is 2.5% (0.42 million) below Bell's 16.8 million estimate.

coverage: U.S. Census Bureau, Statistical Abstract of the United States: 2003 (123rd ed.), Table No. 467: Governmental Employment and Payrolls: 1980 to 2001.
excerpt: No. 467. Governmental Employment and Payrolls: 1980 to 2001 ... Total: 16,213 (thousands) in October 1980 (Federal civilian 2,898; State and local 13,315).
limitation: Annual October snapshot covering full-time and part-time civilian employees (differs slightly from BLS CES annual average); shows 16.21 million in Oct 1980, 3.5% (0.59 million) below Bell's 16.8 million estimate.

coverage: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）私营教育与医疗服务业（CES6500000001，1968—1985及2016—2025年）及私营医疗与社会援助业（CES6562000001，1990—2025年）季调就业人数官方序列
excerpt: BLS CES6500000001 (All Employees, Private Education and Health Services, seasonally adjusted, in thousands): 1968 annual avg 4,190.8; 1973 annual avg 5,091.7; 1975 annual avg 5,496.6; 1977 annual avg 6,052.0; 1980 annual avg 7,076.3; 2025-01 27,006.0. BLS CES6562000001 (Health Care and Social Assistance): 1990 annual avg 9,336.0; 2025 annual avg 23,291.0.
limitation: CES6500000001和CES6562000001覆盖整个私营部门（含非营利与营利机构），不单独按501(c)(3)免税身份拆分，且不含公立医院、公立高校与独立政府科研机构；作为1968—1980及1973—2025年美国医疗与教育服务业就业扩张的官方回顾性代理序列。

coverage: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）与约翰斯·霍普金斯公民社会研究中心2013—2017年全美501(c)(3)非营利部门就业份额、增速与行业地位报告摘要
excerpt: Nonprofit employment has continued its record of growth, expanding by 2 percent between 2016 and 2017, compared to 1.5 percent growth in for-profit employment... making it the third largest workforce of all U.S. industries.
limitation: 属于行业媒体对BLS与Johns Hopkins 2013—2017年非营利就业数据的二手报道，且数据仅覆盖至2017年，未提供1973—2007年的分年非营利就业序列。

coverage: Joynt等发表于JAMA（2014年10月）的2003—2010年美国急诊医院转为营利性机构（for-profit conversion）的回顾性队列研究
excerpt: An increasing number of hospitals have converted to for-profit status, prompting concerns that these hospitals will focus on payer mix and profits... Retrospective cohort study conducted among 237 converting hospitals and 631 matched control hospitals.
limitation: 仅提供PubMed官方摘要，聚焦2003—2010年间转为营利性的237家急诊医院的财务与临床结果，未统计全美非营利医院总就业人数的净增减。

coverage: 美国内科医师学会（ACP）发表于Annals of Internal Medicine（2021年）关于过去数十年美国医疗体系企业化、营利性与私募股权投资扩张及非营利转营利趋势的立场文件
excerpt: The steady growth of corporate interest and influence in the health care sector over the past few decades has created a more business-oriented health care system in the United States, helping to spur for-profit and private equity investment.
limitation: 立场文件摘要属于定性制度综述，未提供非营利与营利医疗就业占比的长期时间序列数值，用作医疗领域商业化与营利化扩张的边界反证。

coverage: 皮尤研究中心（Pew Research Center）2009年美国科学家（含高校学术界与非营利机构）与美国普通公众政治意识形态及党派认同对比调查
excerpt: Slightly more than half of scientists (52%) describe their own political views as liberal, including 14% who describe themselves as very liberal. Most scientists identify as Democrats (55%), while 32% identify as independents and just 6% say they are Republicans. Majorities of scientists working in academia (60%), for non-profits (55%) and in government (52%) call themselves Democrats.
limitation: 调查对象为美国科学促进会（AAAS）成员科学家与全美公众，时点为2009年（晚于1975年），未涵盖医疗临床人员与基础教育教师，也未直接测量文化消费市场规模。

coverage: Bonica、Rosenthal与Rothman发表于JAMA Internal Medicine（2014年8月）的1991—2012年美国医生联邦选举政治捐款倾向、营利/非营利执业差异与专科分化实证研究
excerpt: Between 1991 and 2012, the political alignment of US physicians shifted from predominantly Republican toward the Democrats. Contributions to Republicans in 2011 to 2012 were more prevalent among men vs women (52.3% vs 23.6%), physicians practicing in for-profit vs nonprofit organizations (53.2% vs 25.6%), and surgeons vs pediatricians (70.2% vs 22.1%).
limitation: 数据覆盖1991—2012年而非1975年，且以参与联邦竞选捐款的活跃医生（占比从2.6%升至9.4%）作为政治倾向代理指标，可能高于一般非捐款医生及护士等其他医疗从业者的政治活跃度。

coverage: 21 Western democracies including the United States, 1948-2020 electoral cleavages by education and income (Gethin, Martínez-Toledano & Piketty, QJE)
excerpt: higher-educated voters now vote for the “left,” while high-income voters continue to vote for the “right.”
limitation: Covers higher-educated voters across 21 Western democracies rather than isolating US nonprofit sector employees specifically; retrieved via Crossref scholarly metadata abstract.

coverage: United States adult ideological consistency by education and generational cohort, 1994-2015 (Pew Research Center)
excerpt: More than half of those with postgraduate experience (54%) have either consistently liberal political values (31%) or mostly liberal values (23%)
limitation: Education level is a proxy for knowledge/research/education professionals rather than direct nonprofit-sector employment; generational cohort figures cover all Boomers and Silents rather than college-only cohorts.

coverage: US physicians federal campaign contributions by nonprofit vs for-profit setting and specialty, 1991-2012 (Bonica, Rosenthal & Rothman, JAMA Internal Medicine)
excerpt: Contributions to Republicans in 2011 to 2012 were more prevalent among men vs women (52.3% vs 23.6%), physicians practicing in for-profit vs nonprofit organizations (53.2% vs 25.6%), and surgeons vs pediatricians (70.2% vs 22.1%).
limitation: Covers physicians who made federal campaign contributions (9.4% of active physicians in 2011-2012) rather than all healthcare workers; observation ends in 2012.

coverage: Survey of US (Indiana) nonprofit organizations' participation in political advocacy and resources devoted to it (Child & Grønbjerg, Social Science Quarterly)
excerpt: Our findings suggest that most nonprofits are ambivalent about advocacy. Some do no advocacy at all; many participate in some form of it although it does not constitute their primary purpose or mission; and only a small minority devotes considerable resources to it.
limitation: Based on a large state-level survey of Indiana nonprofits rather than a full national census; retrieved via Crossref abstract.

coverage: Politically active US 501(c)(4) social welfare nonprofit organizations among >80,000 organizations (Nonprofit and Voluntary Sector Quarterly)
excerpt: We estimate that approximately 15% of (c)(4)s likely pursue advocacy or political action, while most are engaged in unrelated activities.
limitation: Focuses specifically on 501(c)(4) social welfare nonprofits rather than 501(c)(3) charities (which face even stricter legal restrictions on lobbying); retrieved via Crossref abstract.

coverage: US registered voters party identification across age cohorts born 1940s-1990s, 1994-2023 (Pew Research Center)
excerpt: Voters born in the 1950s (ages 64 to 73 in 2023) are more likely to be Republicans or Republican leaners (52%) than Democrats or Democratic leaners (44%). The GOP has held an edge with this group for the last several years, following growth in GOP affiliation over the last 15 years.
limitation: Tracks party identification across entire birth cohorts rather than isolating college graduates within each birth cohort; partisan shift combines aging and period effects.

coverage: US national three-wave panel study (1965, 1973, 1982) of Vietnam-era college-educated protesters and nonprotesters (M. Kent Jennings, APSR)
excerpt: Very strong continuities emerge for attitudes associated with the protestors' political baptism. Although erosion effects appear in more contemporary affairs, the protest generation remains quite distinctive.
limitation: Panel waves in this article cover 1965 to 1982 (up to early/mid-30s); retrieved via Crossref abstract.

coverage: Long-term US national panel study of the high school class of 1965 (student protest cohort) into mid-life (M. Kent Jennings, Political Psychology)
excerpt: The results show that a sharp rift in political participation and attitudes emerged between protesters and non‐protesters during the protest era, a rift that persists into mid‐life and one that testifies to the conceptual utility of generation units.
limitation: Tracks cohort into mid-life (around age 50) rather than old age; retrieved via Crossref abstract.

coverage: 25 U.S. General Social Surveys (1972-2004) decomposing intracohort aging and sociopolitical attitudes (Danigelis, Hardy & Cutler, ASR)
excerpt: the direction of change is most often toward increased tolerance rather than increased conservatism.
limitation: Covers US general population cohorts (not college-only) and focuses on social tolerance, civil liberties, and privacy items through 2004; retrieved via Crossref abstract.

coverage: US registered voters partisanship by educational attainment, 1994-2023 (Pew Research Center)
excerpt: College graduates moved in the opposite direction, becoming more Democratic over this same period.
limitation: Cross-sectional trend of college graduates as a demographic group (combining cohort replacement and intra-cohort change) rather than a pure panel of a single graduating class.

coverage: U.S. nationwide occupational licensing prevalence and wage effects among workers by education and union status (2006 Gallup survey; NBER Working Paper 14308, Kleiner & Krueger).
excerpt: In 2006, 29 percent of the U.S. workforce was required to hold an occupational license from a government agency; workers with higher levels of education are more likely to work in jobs that require a license, and licensing yields about a 15 percent wage premium without reducing wage dispersion like unions.
limitation: 该工作论文基于2006年全美盖洛普抽样调查，属于截面数据而非1973年至2026年连续时间序列；职业许可仅是“传统专业主义”的制度代理指标，不能直接等同于所有受过教育劳动者的主观意识形态认同。

coverage: American Medical Association (AMA) Physician Practice Benchmark Survey (2012-2024): U.S. physician practice ownership, corporate/hospital employment, compensation methods, and telehealth adoption.
excerpt: Between 2012 and 2024, the share of U.S. physicians working in private practices dropped from 60.1% to 42.2% as practices shifted to hospital, private equity, or insurer ownership; 70.5% received salary compensation in 2024, and telehealth use rose from 25.1% in 2018 to 71.4% in 2024.
limitation: 数据覆盖非联邦政府雇佣且每周接诊至少20小时的美国执业医师，时间序列始于2012年而非1973年；医师群体虽是传统专业主义的典型代表，但不能等同于全部受过教育的劳动者。

coverage: Peer-reviewed commentary in Academic Medicine (PMID 39018433) on the resurgence of U.S. resident and fellow physician unionization since 2022 in a corporatized health care landscape.
excerpt: There is a growing trend of resident and fellow physician unionization in the United States, with 14 new housestaff unions formed at private employers since 2022, responding to burnout, undercompensation, and inadequate representation in an increasingly corporatized health care landscape.
limitation: 该文为《Academic Medicine》评述性论文，聚焦美国住院医师与专科培训医师（housestaff）的工会化回潮，反映的是受过教育专业人群中青年受雇医生的集体抗争动向，尚不能代表全部资深专业人士或其他行业。

coverage: Pew Research Center report 'The State of American Jobs: 1. Changes in the American workplace' analyzing U.S. occupational structure and skill demand shifts from 1980 to 2015 using O*NET and CPS data.
excerpt: Manufacturing employment declined by about a third since 1990 while employment in knowledge-intensive and service-oriented sectors (education, health, professional and business services) about doubled; jobs shifted toward social and analytical skills and adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher rose from 17% in 1980 to 33% in 2015.
limitation: 该报告观察区间主要覆盖1980年至2015年的美国劳动力市场（制造业降幅自1990年起算），未涵盖1973-1979年及2016年以后的变化，且聚焦美国单一经济体。

coverage: David H. Autor, 'Polanyi's Paradox and the Shape of Employment Growth' (NBER Working Paper 20485, September 2014), reviewing five decades of computerization and labor market polarization.
excerpt: Computerization over the past five decades produced labor market polarization—the simultaneous growth of high-education, high-wage and low-education, low-wage jobs—while machine substitution for adaptable, common-sense human tasks remains overstated.
limitation: 该工作论文摘要综述截至2014年的约五十年计算机化与就业极化演变，侧重宏观任务结构极化，未单独拆解2015年后生成式AI对专业工作的最新冲击。

coverage: 1970年代美国及国际工厂与企业的工人参与和工作生活质量（QWL）改革实践
excerpt: As production has become more dehumanized and workers have become increasingly dissatisfied and alienated, the quality of their work has suffered. To offset this malaise, various experiments have been conducted to improve the quality of work life and to give workers a voice in management decisionmaking.
limitation: ERIC 官方档案摘要仅保留年份（1978）且缺乏长期受控实验数据；反映1970年代末期改革潮，不能单独代表1980年代之后的长期结果。

coverage: 1970-1980年代美国钢铁与汽车制造业（USW、UAW、通用、福特等）多工厂工人参与与QWL项目研究
excerpt: Chapter 3 reviews the experiences of two major national unions and their industries--the United Steel Workers and seven major steel companies and the United Automobile Workers and General Motors and Ford Motor Company--with worker participation processes scattered across multiple plants.
limitation: ERIC 官方档案仅记录年份（1984）及专著结构摘要，未提供具体量化参与率，且反映1980年代中期美国制造业工会的阶段性经验。

coverage: 48家日本制造工厂的参与式决策与工人实际权力实证调查
excerpt: Data on 48 Japanese manufacturing plants suggest that participative decision making has not led to workplace democracy. Although workers are allowed to present ideas and suggestions, they do not have authority to make decisions, particularly in strategic, organizationwide situations.
limitation: 样本为日本制造业工厂而非美国工厂，但作为精益与参与式工厂管理的全球标杆样本，可直接检验“参与形式”与“实际工作决策控制权”之间的落差；ERIC 仅记录发表年份（1992）。

coverage: 近三十年西方制造业精益生产主导地位及2020年代北美（魁北克）铝业与橡胶业工厂数字化精益重组实证研究
excerpt: An analysis of the aluminum and rubber manufacturing sectors identifies two models of work organization, Empowered Digital Lean and Taylorized Digital Lean systems. The study shows that differences between the two regimes result from differing product markets, production characteristics and levels of workers’ power, while highlighting potential points of resistance for labor.
limitation: 四家工厂案例位于加拿大魁北克而非美国本土，但其对近三十年西方制造业精益生产主导范式及两种分化体制的归纳具有代表性。

coverage: 1995-2023年全球本科医学教育引入社会问责制（Social Accountability）的范围综述
excerpt: Social accountability (SA) of medical schools has been described as the obligation of medical institutions to direct their education, research, and service activities toward addressing the priority health needs and concerns of the community, region, and/or nation they are obligated to [1].
limitation: 聚焦医学教育领域（贝尔后文明确举出的核心专业示例），未直接覆盖法律、工程等其他专业；且综述同时指出全球实际落地进展仍较为缓慢。

coverage: 近几十年美国医疗体系企业化、金融化与私募股权（PE）并购医院及诊所的结构性变迁
excerpt: The corporatization of health care refers to the increasing influence of financial markets, motives, and institutions on the delivery and structure of health care. Corporatization results in a system driven primarily by profit, investment returns, and economic metrics.
limitation: 主要聚焦美国医疗卫生体系及私募股权模式，反映的是医疗机构治理与执业关系的结构性商业化，不直接等同于所有医生个人价值观的测量。

coverage: 近25年美国医疗与健康服务商品化、企业化与整合趋势的文献综述
excerpt: The commodification of health and health care substantially worsened in the US, characterized by increased health care corporatization and consolidation, biomedical lobbying, and unaffordable costs.
limitation: 聚焦美国医疗卫生系统，属于针对性文献综述与规范性分析，不涵盖全部非医疗专业行业。

coverage: 对史蒂文·布林特（Steven Brint）关于专业主义从“社会受托人专业主义”转向“专家专业主义”命题的跨专业实证检验
excerpt: Furthermore our findings support an orientation towards "expert professionalism" rather than "social trustee professionalism." "But," embedded in the perspective of an expert there is an emphasis on ethical knowledge, moral and/or societal responsibility and the wish to do good for others. However, the students' sense of responsibility seems to be restricted to certain "localism" of their specific occupation.
limitation: 实证访谈样本来自挪威奥斯陆大学三个专业项目新生，ERIC 仅记录发表年份（2006）；但该研究直接检验了布林特关于当代西方专业群体从社会受托人转向专家型专业主义的核心社会学命题。

coverage: 美国联邦医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）《NHE Fact Sheet》2024年美国国家医疗支出结构与参保率实绩
excerpt: NHE grew 7.2% to $5.3 trillion in 2024, or $15,474 per person, and accounted for 18.0% of Gross Domestic Product (GDP). Medicare spending grew 7.8% to $1,118.0 billion in 2024, or 21 percent of total NHE. Medicaid spending grew 6.6% to $931.7 billion in 2024, or 18 percent of total NHE. Private health insurance spending grew 8.8% to $1,644.6 billion in 2024, or 31 percent of total NHE. Out of pocket spending grew 5.9% to $556.6 billion in 2024, or 11 percent of total NHE.
limitation: 该表统计美国医疗支出资金来源与机构类别（医院与医师服务），证明商业保险与政府医保成为绝对主导且医院支出居首，但不直接拆分保险支付内部按服务收费（FFS）与按人头/价值付费的结算方式。

coverage: 美国医疗支付学习与行动网络（HCP-LAN）2024年替代性支付模式测算报告（CY 2023全美各险种医疗支付分类，覆盖2.829亿参保人即92.7%医保覆盖人群）
excerpt: For All LOB, 54.8% of payments were Categories 1 and 2, 16.7% were Category 3A, 14.3% were Category 3B, 14.2% were Category 4, and Categories 3B and 4 together accounted for 28.5% of payments.
limitation: 该数据反映CY 2023美国医保支付方对医疗服务提供方的结算模式结构（其中Category 1为无质量挂钩的传统按服务收费FFS，Category 2为质量挂钩的FFS），属于美国单国数据，但覆盖92.7%美国医保覆盖人群。

coverage: JAMA Network Open 基于美国社区调查（ACS）2001—2015年99,077名美国医生样本的自雇与受雇比例及收入差异研究
excerpt: The weighted percentage of self-employed physicians decreased from 35.2% (95% CI, 34.4%-36.1%; 6807 of 18 726 physicians) in 2001 through 2005 to 24.7% (95% CI, 24.2%-25.2%; 10 974 of 41 205 physicians) in 2011 through 2015.
limitation: 样本观察期止于2015年，且以美国社区调查自报自雇身份衡量医生个体开业状态，未进一步拆分2015年之后的最新变化。

coverage: JSLS 2025年基于美国人口普查局（SUSB）与劳工统计局（OEWS）近二十年（至2022年）全美76万名医生执业组织与雇佣形态统计研究
excerpt: Hospital employment rose by 33%, while private medical practices grew by 17%. Currently, 55% of physicians work in private practices, down 3% from a decade ago, and 27% are hospital employed, up from 25% from a decade ago.
limitation: 基于NAICS行业分类（SUSB/OEWS）统计医师所在机构归属，私营诊所口径中同时包含医生自有独立诊所、大型团体执业诊所及企业/私募持股诊所，因此与纯“个体医生独资开业”口径存在差异。

coverage: 世界银行WDI官方序列（NV.IND.EMPL.KD与NV.SRV.EMPL.KD，2015年不变价美元人均增加值），1991/1995—2024年OECD成员国整体及英、德、日、法实绩
excerpt: OECD members (OED): Industry value added per worker rose from $49,395.4 in 1995 to $63,964.8 in 2010 and $68,869.8 in 2024 (+39.4%), whereas Services value added per worker rose from $55,697.4 in 1995 to $59,660.5 in 2010 and $63,290.0 in 2024 (+13.6%).
limitation: 以人均增加值（按就业人数计而非按工时计）作为部门劳动生产率宏观代理，未按细分服务业拆分，且该WDI序列中美国仅报告2015年单年值（工业$112,118.0 vs 服务业$116,154.6）；同时显示2024年德、法服务业绝对人均增加值水平仍高于工业。

coverage: 纽约联邦储备银行《Economic Policy Review》Triplett & Bosworth (2003) 对美国1973—2001年27个细分服务业劳动生产率与多要素生产率的实证研究
excerpt: Using the 1977-95 period as the base, we showed that fifteen of twenty-two U.S. two-digit services industries experienced productivity acceleration. Both the rate of LP improvement in services after 1995 and its acceleration equaled the economywide average. That is why we said 'Baumol's Disease has been cured.'
limitation: 该研究实证窗口截止于2001年且聚焦美国市场，主要反映1995—2001年信息技术投资热潮带来的美国服务业生产率加速，不代表所有服务业在所有时期均维持同等增速。

coverage: 世界银行旗舰报告《At Your Service?: The Promise of Services-Led Development (Overview)》（基于20国企业微观数据及OECD与Eurostat 2010—2017年各细分服务业与制造业生产率对比）
excerpt: There is substantial variation in labor productivity and total factor productivity (TFP) across subsectors. Global innovator services are the most productive. (For example, ICT services are 1.5 times as productive as manufacturing across LMICs.) Low-skill domestic services (especially hospitality and retail) tend to be the least productive.
limitation: 20国企业级相对生产率对比基于2010—2017年最新可得年份，且报告同时指出在发展中国家与高收入国家中，酒店餐饮与零售等低技能本土服务业生产率仍然偏低。

coverage: World Bank WDI (ILO modeled estimate) Employment in services (% of total employment) for United States and OECD members, 1991-2025.
excerpt: United States employment in services (% of total employment, SL.SRV.EMPL.ZS) rose from 72.69% in 1991 to 79.56% in 2025; OECD members rose from 61.04% in 1991 to 74.03% in 2025.
limitation: World Bank ILO modeled series begins in 1991 rather than 1973, so it confirms the continued post-1991 shift into services rather than providing a single continuous series from 1973.

coverage: William D. Nordhaus (NBER Working Paper 12218, May 2006), empirical test of Baumol's cost-price disease and growth disease on US industry data for 1948-2001.
excerpt: Industries with relatively low productivity growth show a percentage-point for percentage-point higher growth in relative prices, and the growth disease lowered US annual aggregate productivity growth by slightly more than one-half percentage point over 1948-2001.
limitation: Sample period ends in 2001 and relies on industry value-added data where output in health, education, and personal services is often measured by inputs.

coverage: Jack E. Triplett and Barry P. Bosworth (Federal Reserve Bank of New York Economic Policy Review, September 2003), US services industry labor and multifactor productivity acceleration after 1995.
excerpt: Fifteen of twenty-two US two-digit services industries experienced productivity acceleration after 1995, matching the economywide average.
limitation: Covers the 1977-2001 US post-1995 ICT productivity surge and does not cover the subsequent post-2005 productivity slowdown.

coverage: NBER Working Paper 23979 (October 2017), Relative Prices and Sectoral Productivity: cross-country disaggregation of traditional vs non-traditional service prices and productivity.
excerpt: Aggregate service relative prices rise driven by housing, collective government, and health, whereas transportation, communication, and finance show declining relative prices and higher productivity elasticity than manufacturing.
limitation: Cross-country development accounting study rather than a single-country US time series from 1973 to 2025.

coverage: Our World in Data, Healthcare Spending (first published June 2017, updated March 2024): long-run private and public healthcare expenditure trends in the US and high-income countries.
excerpt: In the US, healthcare expenditure increased in recent decades in both private and public channels, per capita and as a share of GDP.
limitation: Focuses specifically on healthcare spending rather than all private and governmental services, and attributes growth partly to expanding medical technologies alongside cost dynamics.

coverage: Our World in Data / OECD SOCX (2025), OECD (1985), Lindert (2004): Public social expenditure and general government expenditure as a share of GDP in major OECD economies, 1973-2024.
excerpt: Public social expenditure as a share of GDP roughly doubled in the US from 9.94% (1973) to 19.81% (2024) and rose sharply across UK, Germany, France, Japan, and Sweden.
limitation: Measures realized fiscal expenditure as a proxy for public demand for government social goods/activities, which also reflects demographic aging and statutory entitlement formulas.

coverage: Our World in Data, Government Spending (first published October 2016, updated April 2025): historical expansion of social spending, post-1980 slowdown, and private-sector delivery/PPPs.
excerpt: Early-industrialized countries saw remarkable 20th-century growth in public social spending for healthcare and education, while post-1980 total spending growth slowed and governments increasingly relied on private-sector delivery.
limitation: High-level synthesis across early-industrialized countries; post-1980 deceleration applies to total government spending rather than negating absolute per-capita and social-spending growth.

coverage: Pew Research Center, Public Trust in Government: 1958-2025 (updated December 4, 2025): long-run decline in Americans' trust in the federal government.
excerpt: Just 17% of Americans say they trust the federal government to do what is right always or most of the time, down from 73% in 1958.
limitation: Measures political trust in Washington rather than direct demand for specific social-need programs (such as healthcare, Social Security, or education), serving as a boundary check on attitudes toward government.

coverage: 世界银行 WDI 中央政府总债务占 GDP 比重（GC.DOD.TOTL.GD.ZS），覆盖 1989–2024 年美国、英国、加拿大、瑞士等发达经济体实绩。
excerpt: United States central government debt rose from 39.13% of GDP in 1989 to 115.79% in 2024; United Kingdom rose from 30.20% in 1990 to 130.74% in 2024.
limitation: 该指标仅统计中央政府债务且部分国家自1989/1990年起才有连续序列，未覆盖1973–1988年及地方政府债务；瑞士同期债务率始终低于30%构成国别边界。

coverage: Our World in Data 整理的 IMF（2025）历史公共财政数据库，覆盖 1973–2024 年美国、法国、意大利、德国、日本、英国、加拿大等主要西方发达国家政府总支出占 GDP 比重。
excerpt: From 1973 to 2024, government expenditure as a share of GDP increased across major Western economies: USA from 31.92% to 37.92%, France from 19.75% to 57.17%, Italy from 35.26% to 50.56%, Japan from 23.27% to 39.10%, and Germany from 42.38% to 49.43%.
limitation: 政府支出占GDP比重上升本身反映公共职能与福利体系扩张，并不单独等同于财政违约或不可持续，需结合赤字与债务指标共同判读。

coverage: NBER Working Paper w16782（Ghosh, Kim, Mendoza, Ostry & Qureshi, 2011年2月），基于 1970–2007 年 23 个发达经济体面板数据实证研究主权债务可持续性与“财政疲劳”。
excerpt: Using data for 23 advanced economies over 1970-2007, we find evidence of a fiscal reaction function with these features, and use it to compute "fiscal space," defined as the difference between projected debt ratios and debt limits.
limitation: 样本期止于2007年（全球金融危机与新冠疫情前），主要提供结构性财政疲劳机制的跨国计量证据，需与2008–2024年实际财政数据配合使用。

coverage: 世界银行 WDI 中央政府净贷出(+)/净借入(-)占 GDP 比重（GC.NLD.TOTL.GD.ZS），覆盖 1972–2024 年 10 个西方发达经济体年度财政收支实绩。
excerpt: In 2024, central government net lending/borrowing stood at -7.19% of GDP in the USA, -6.86% in the UK, -5.24% in France, and -3.44% in Italy; however, the USA achieved a surplus of +2.23% in 2000, and Switzerland (+0.49%), Denmark (+4.20%), and Norway (+13.55%) recorded surpluses in 2024.
limitation: 中央政府口径不含地方政府与部分独立社会保障基金，且挪威财政盈余高度受石油主权基金资源收入影响，不代表一般后工业国家的普遍财政约束。

coverage: 世界银行 WDI 工业与服务业人均增加值（2015年不变美元，NV.IND.EMPL.KD 与 NV.SRV.EMPL.KD），覆盖 1991–2024 年瑞士、德国、法国、英国、日本、瑞典实绩。
excerpt: From 1991 to 2024, cumulative growth in services value added per worker lagged industry across all six economies (GBR +39.2% vs +88.6%, FRA +22.8% vs +42.2%, DEU +26.1% vs +39.9%, CHE +14.6% vs +80.8%, SWE +51.3% vs +167.9%, JPN 1994-2024 +5.4% vs +48.5%); however, during 2010-2024 services outpaced industry in Germany (+7.9% vs +5.7%) and France (+8.6% vs +7.2%).
limitation: 该序列自1991年起算且美国仅含基准年数据，未能单独拆分政府部门与商业服务业，也未按工时调整；但清晰揭示了长期整体落后与2010–2024年阶段性反超并存。

coverage: NBER Working Paper w12218（William D. Nordhaus, 2006年5月），基于 1948–2001 年美国分行业数据实证检验鲍莫尔成本病与停滞部门对整体生产率的拖累。
excerpt: Using industry data for the period 1948-2001, the present study investigates Baumol's diseases for the overall economy. It finds that technologically stagnant sectors clearly have rising relative prices and declining relative real outputs.
limitation: 数据窗口为1948–2001年，未覆盖2002年之后的数字经济与生成式AI阶段，且侧重宏观部门转移而非单个新兴ICT服务业。

coverage: 纽约联邦储备银行《经济政策评论》（2003年9月），Jack E. Triplett & Barry P. Bosworth 对 1977–2000 年美国 27 个细分服务业劳动生产率与全要素生产率（MFP）的权威实证测算。
excerpt: Using the 1977-95 period as the base, we showed that fifteen of twenty-two U.S. two-digit services industries experienced productivity acceleration. Both the rate of LP improvement in services after 1995 and its acceleration equaled the economywide average. That is why we said "Baumol's Disease has been cured."
limitation: 该研究聚焦1995–2000年美国私营商业服务业（如批发零售、金融、电信与IT密集型服务），并未涵盖一般政府部门的产出效率，且后续研究指出其加速在欧陆及传统个人服务中并不普遍。

coverage: U.S. federal budget deficits, surpluses (FY1998-FY2001), public debt, and net interest payments (FY1976-Aug 2026)
excerpt: From FY1976 to FY2025, the average net deficit equaled 3.6% of annual GDP; federal debt reached $40.2 trillion as of August 31, 2026, with surpluses recorded only in FY1998-FY2001.
limitation: Covers U.S. federal finances only (not state/local or non-U.S. OECD countries); includes FY2026 CBO projections alongside realized FY1976-FY2025 and Aug 2026 debt stock figures.

coverage: U.S. Treasury official historical gross federal debt outstanding from FY1973 to FY2026
excerpt: U.S. gross federal debt outstanding increased from $458.14 billion on 1973-06-30 (FY1973) to $40.172 trillion on 2026-09-30 (FY2026).
limitation: Reports nominal gross debt outstanding (including intragovernmental holdings) without GDP or inflation scaling; must be read alongside debt-to-GDP ratios.

coverage: World Bank central government debt as % of GDP for the United States (1989-2024)
excerpt: U.S. central government debt rose from 39.13% of GDP in 1989 to 115.79% of GDP in 2024.
limitation: World Bank series begins in 1989 rather than 1973 and covers central government debt rather than consolidated general government debt.

coverage: World Bank central government debt as % of GDP for Switzerland (1990-2024)
excerpt: Switzerland kept central government debt contained at 12.14% of GDP in 1990, 25.49% in 2000, and 22.28% in 2024.
limitation: Represents a small post-industrial economy with a constitutional debt brake; does not negate fiscal deterioration in the U.S. and larger Western economies.

coverage: U.S. manufacturing employment decline (2000-2010), partial rebound (2010-2019), output growth, and multi-factor causes
excerpt: U.S. manufacturing employment fell from 17.1 million at the start of the 21st century to 13.7 million in Dec 2007 and 12.9 million in 2019 despite a 12% rebound after Feb 2010, while its share of total employment continued to decline.
limitation: Report data ends in 2019; also shows post-2010 cyclical rebound and 24% output growth since 2009, demonstrating that automation and productivity alongside trade drove job erosion.

coverage: Long-term U.S. union membership and union density trends (1880-2022)
excerpt: U.S. union membership peaked at about 21 million in 1979, and union density declined steadily from 22.2% in 1980 to 9.4% (nonfarm basis) / 10.1% (CPS wage-and-salary basis) in 2022.
limitation: Reports economy-wide union density rather than manufacturing-only headcount; corroborates the broader labor-organization decline referenced by Bell.

coverage: World Bank/ILO U.S. employment in industry as % of total employment (1991-2025)
excerpt: U.S. employment in industry fell from 24.37% of total employment in 1991 to 22.67% in 2000, 19.49% in 2010, and 18.91% in 2025.
limitation: ILO industry category includes construction and mining in addition to manufacturing, and begins in 1991; used as a transparent post-2019 proxy confirming no structural reversal.

coverage: International comparison of U.S. manufacturing employment and value-added output (1990-2016)
excerpt: Between 1990 and 2016, U.S. manufacturing employment fell by a smaller percentage than in the UK, France, Sweden, and Japan, while U.S. manufacturing value added outperformed many wealthy peers from 2008 to 2016.
limitation: Data ends in 2016; provides international boundary context showing manufacturing job erosion was widespread across advanced economies and did not mean U.S. output collapse.

coverage: 美国1990年关税与数量进口限制（含纺织品与服装等21个高保护行业）的消费者成本与每保住一个就业岗位的成本测算（PIIE，Hufbauer & Elliott 1994）
excerpt: This comprehensive study finds that tariffs and quantitative import restrictions in place in 1990 cost American consumers about $70 billion, more than 1 percent of GDP.
limitation: 页面为PIIE专著官方简介页，呈现1990年截面测算汇总而非分行业逐年时间序列；发表日期仅精确到年月（1994-01）。

coverage: 2018年美国关税战对国内进口品价格传导、消费者负担及美国实际收入损失的实证研究（NBER Working Paper 25672，Amiti, Redding & Weinstein 2019）
excerpt: Overall, using standard economic methods, we find that the full incidence of the tariff falls on domestic consumers, with a reduction in U.S. real income of $1.4 billion per month by the end of 2018.
limitation: 研究聚焦2018年单年关税冲击的短期价格与福利效应，未覆盖1970—1990年代保护主义周期；发表日期仅精确到年月（2019-03）。

coverage: 美国2012/2016/2018年多轮洗衣机进口限制对零售价格及生产转移效应的实证研究（NBER Working Paper 25767，Flaaen, Hortaçsu & Tintelnot 2019）
excerpt: We find that in response to the 2018 tariffs on nearly all source countries, the price of washers rose by nearly 12 percent; the price of dryers—a complementary good not subject to tariffs—increased by an equivalent amount.
limitation: 仅针对洗衣机及互补家电（干衣机）细分行业，且显示针对单一国家的反倾销税（如2012年对韩、2016年对华）会因生产转移而减弱甚至压低美国零售价；发表日期仅精确到年月（2019-04）。

coverage: 美联储关于2018—2019年美国关税对本土制造业就业、产出与生产者价格净影响的实证研究（FEDS 2019-086，Flaaen & Pierce 2019）
excerpt: We find that U.S. manufacturing industries more exposed to tariff increases experience relative reductions in employment as a positive effect from import protection is offset by larger negative effects from rising input costs and retaliatory tariffs.
limitation: 评估对象为2018—2019年关税冲击下的美国制造业整体及投入产出链条，衡量的是生产者价格与相对就业变化而非单一消费品零售价；发表日期仅精确到年月（2019-12）。

coverage: 2018—2019年美国关税战对受保护行业就业与报复性关税地区就业影响的地方层面实证研究（NBER Working Paper 32082，Autor, Beck, Dorn & Hanson 2024）
excerpt: The trade-war has not to date provided economic help to the US heartland: import tariffs on foreign goods neither raised nor lowered US employment in newly-protected sectors; retaliatory tariffs had clear negative employment impacts, primarily in agriculture; and these harms were only partly mitigated by compensatory US agricultural subsidies.
limitation: 聚焦2018—2019年贸易战及后续数年的地理层面就业效应，不涵盖1970—1990年代纺织/汽车配额时期；发表日期仅精确到年月（2024-01）。

coverage: 美国1996年福利改革（PRWORA）终结贫困家庭现金福利法定权利及其在大衰退期间响应性的实证研究（NBER Working Paper 16504，Bitler & Hoynes 2010）
excerpt: Importantly, along with other changes, the reform imposed lifetime time limits for receipt of welfare de facto ending the entitlement nature of cash welfare for poor families with children in the United States.
limitation: 聚焦美国低收入有子女家庭的现金与非现金安全网项目（AFDC/TANF、食品券等），不能单独代表全部社会政策实验空间；发表日期仅精确到年月（2010-10）。

coverage: 美国联邦预算历史趋势、当前约100%的债务/GDP比率及中长期财政缺口评估（NBER Working Paper 34455，Auerbach & Gale 2025）
excerpt: These figures compare to a current debt-GDP ratio of about 100% and a pre-OBBBA CBO analysis earlier this year that projected the 2054 debt-GDP ratio to be 154%.
limitation: 包含对2054年债务比率的预测值，评估仅采用其截至2025年约100%债务/GDP比率的现实观察，不将2054年预测当作实绩；发表日期仅精确到年月（2025-11）。

coverage: 美国近三十年联邦自主性支出（国防与非国防）占GDP比重停滞及债务压力对预算空间挤压的研究（NBER Working Paper 35257，Dynan, Elmendorf & Gullo 2026）
excerpt: Both defense and nondefense discretionary spending show no trend relative to national output over the past three decades, reflecting underlying factors rather than explicit targets.
limitation: 聚焦联邦年度自主性支出（discretionary spending），不含法定社会保险支出（Social Security/Medicare）的扩张；发表日期仅精确到年月（2026-05）。

coverage: 2010年《平价医疗法案》（ACA）Medicaid扩张与联邦医保补贴对美国医保覆盖率提升的实证研究（NBER Working Paper 23607，Duggan, Goda & Jackson 2017）
excerpt: Our findings indicate that the majority of the increase in health insurance coverage since 2013 is due to the ACA and that areas in which the potential Medicaid and exchange enrollments were higher saw substantially larger increases in coverage.
limitation: 主要评估ACA实施后头两年（2013—2015）的覆盖率与劳动力市场影响，仅反映医疗社会政策维度；发表日期仅精确到年月（2017-07）。

coverage: 美国疫情衰退期联邦大规模社会安全网扩张（UI、SNAP等）与大衰退期对比研究（NBER Working Paper 31518，Hembre, Moffitt & Ziliak 2023，2026-06修订）
excerpt: The federal government enacted massive spending in the Pandemic Recession.
limitation: 疫情期扩张属于应急反周期政策，且TANF与SSI响应较弱，不能等同于常态财政宽裕；初发2023-07、修订2026-06，均仅精确到年月。

coverage: 美国两州开展的三年期无条件保障收入（每月1,000美元）随机社会实验实证研究（NBER Working Paper 32719，Vivalt et al. 2024，2026-08修订）
excerpt: We study the causal impacts of income on a rich array of employment outcomes, leveraging an experiment in which 1,000 low-income individuals were randomized into receiving $1,000 per month unconditionally for three years, with a control group of 2,000 participants receiving $50/month.
limitation: 属于非联邦全国立法层面的两州随机试点实验，反映地方/慈善资助社会实验仍活跃，但不能替代联邦财政空间评估；初发2024-07、修订2026-08。

coverage: 2000年以来美国制造业转型与就业大幅下降及其对地区就业率和工资持久负面影响的实证研究（NBER Working Paper 24468，Charles, Hurst & Schwartz 2018）
excerpt: Using data from a variety of sources, this paper comprehensively documents the dramatic changes in the manufacturing sector and the large decline in employment rates and hours worked among prime-aged Americans since 2000.
limitation: 记录2000年代以来美国制造业就业衰退的背景约束，但不直接证明制造业衰退与社会实验余地之间的因果关系；发表日期仅精确到年月（2018-03）。

coverage: 美国私营部门工会化率与工人对工会代表的需求、雇主抵制变化（1977–1984年调查数据）
excerpt: It is also found that there has been a substantial drop in the supply of union jobs relative to demand that is attributed to an increase in employer resistance to unionization. Increased foreign and increased nonunion domestic competition (particularly in deregulated industries) are cited as the likely key underlying causes of these changes.
limitation: 该工作论文主要覆盖1977–1984年阶段，反映1970年代末至1980年代初的转折期，需结合更长期数据观察至2020年代的演变。

coverage: 美国近50年（CPS数据，1970年代至2020年代初）工会与非工会工人的工资及工时溢价
excerpt: The union differential in weekly wages has been more stable. Although it fell by around 5 log points during COVID it remains 15 log points. This weekly earnings differential arises from both a higher hourly wage of around 10 log points and longer working hours (5 log points).
limitation: 衡量的是工会成员与非成员的工资和工时差异，属于劳动成本上升渠道的直接代理，不直接给出企业总体利润率挤压幅度。

coverage: 美国OSHA（职业安全与健康）与EPA监管合规成本对不同类型制造企业工资与利润的非对称影响（1970–1980年代）
excerpt: In this paper we empirically document that the indirect effects produced by these asymmetries mitigate the direct costs of regulations for manyfirms. Large, unionized firms in the Frostbelt are clearly gaining wealth at the expense of small, nonunionized firms in the Sunbelt.
limitation: 聚焦OSHA与EPA监管的直接成本与非对称竞争效应，不能单独涵盖所有非监管类工人工作条件诉求。

coverage: 旧金山联储关于美国劳动收入份额长期下降及其行业结构（贸易与制造业主导、供应链离岸外包）的研究（1980年代末至大衰退后）
excerpt: Over the past quarter century, labor’s share of income in the United States has trended downwards, reaching its lowest level in the postwar period after the Great Recession. ... By contrast, the recent decline has been dominated by trade and manufacturing sectors. ... Finally, we provide evidence that highlights the offshoring of the labor-intensive component of the U.S. supply chain as a leading potential explanation of the decline in the U.S. labor share over the past 25 years.
limitation: 该工作论文发表于2013年，观察期截止至大衰退后（约2012年），需结合2020年代研究延续至截止日。

coverage: 明尼阿波利斯联储（发表于Journal of Economic Perspectives 2024年春季刊）关于美国劳动收入份额截至2022年降至大萧条以来最低水平的研究
excerpt: As of 2022, the share of U.S. income accruing to labor is at its lowest level since the Great Depression.
limitation: 宏观劳动收入份额反映劳动报酬与资本回报的总体分配，并非单一工作条件谈判成本的微观因果估计。

coverage: 波士顿联储关于美国非农商业部门劳动收入份额长期下降及新冠疫情后再度下滑、收入流向企业利润与资本所有者的研究
excerpt: When the labor share falls, a smaller portion of total income goes toward worker compensation, while a larger share flows to corporate profits and capital owners. ... After nearly five decades of relative stability, the labor share declined sharply from the late 1990s to the mid-2000s. It was then relatively stable for a decade after the Great Recession. However, it has been falling again since the COVID-19 pandemic.
limitation: 摘要与引言侧重非农商业部门总体劳动份额与企业市场势力/技术变革关系，未单独拆解工会工作条件诉求的净贡献。

coverage: Our World in Data基于IMF与OECD长期数据库整理的早期工业化国家政府支出占GDP比重演变及公私部门供给格局（19世纪末至21世纪）
excerpt: In early-industrialized countries, specifically, the historical data shows that public spending increased remarkably in the 20th century , as governments started spending more resources on social protection, education, and healthcare. ... Since 1980, the growth of government spending has been slowing down in early-industrialized countries — and in some cases, it has gone down in relative terms. ... Recent data on public spending also shows that governments around the world often rely on the private sector to produce and manage goods and services .
limitation: 综合综述页面汇集IMF与OECD多国历史数据，不同国家口径（一般政府与中央政府）存在差异。

coverage: Our World in Data整理OECD SOCX长期数据库：美国、英国、法国、德国、瑞典公共社会支出占GDP比重（1970–2024年）
excerpt: United States,USA,1970,8.879691 ... United States,USA,2024,19.814; Germany,DEU,1970,16.568996 ... Germany,DEU,2024,27.854; Sweden,SWE,1970,15.849526 ... Sweden,SWE,2024,26.086
limitation: 公共社会支出衡量政府在养老金、医疗与社会保障等领域的再分配规模，不包括全部私人市场商品与服务交易。

coverage: 世界银行国民账户指标NE.CON.PRVT.ZS：美国（USA）与OECD成员国总体（OED）家庭及非营利机构最终消费支出占GDP比重（1973–2024年）
limitation: 家庭最终消费支出包含由政府现金转移支付资助的私人市场消费，但仍以市场价格与个人需求选择为核心配置机制。

coverage: 世界银行国民账户指标NE.CON.GOVT.ZS：美国（USA）与OECD成员国总体（OED）一般政府最终消费支出占GDP比重（1973–2024年）
limitation: 一般政府最终消费支出仅计入政府直接购买和提供的公共商品与服务，不含养老金等现金转移支付，需与公共社会支出并列观察。

coverage: 美国1970-2024年医疗总支出、公共保险与私营保险占比及公共部门医疗支出占比（基于CMS NHE数据）
excerpt: Public insurance represented 42.6% of overall health spending in 2023 (up from 22.0% in 1970), and public spending reached 48% in 2024, while private insurance also rose from 20.4% to 31.2%.

coverage: Analysis of artificial intelligence advances and the modern productivity paradox (expectations vs. measured productivity statistics)
excerpt: Brynjolfsson, Rock, and Syverson (NBER Working Paper 24001, November 2017) document rapid AI technological advances alongside measured productivity slowdown, attributing the gap primarily to implementation lags rather than technological exhaustion.
limitation: Published in November 2017; documents rapid AI capabilities and argues implementation lags explain the paradox, without yet proving full aggregate productivity realization.

coverage: MIT Energy Laboratory燃气轮机与联合循环发电效率1941–1998年技术演进年表
excerpt: 1986年ABB投运的联合循环电厂效率达51.8%，1980年代末才首次出现热效率超过50%的商用联合循环电厂，1990年代末才开始向60%门槛逼近。
limitation: 该报告成稿于1998年8月，对1990年代末突破60%的描述反映当时的工程研发与规划口径，尚未包含2011年后的实际商用净效率纪录。

coverage: Yeh & Rubin (Energy, 2007) 美国煤粉火电厂1900–2004年最高与平均热效率（HHV）长期演进
excerpt: 美国煤粉火电厂最高热效率（HHV）从1900年的8%升至1960年的40%，1980年代后期起新电厂最高效率反降至37%–38%，全美平均保持在33%–34%。
limitation: 以美国煤粉蒸汽火电厂（HHV口径）为主，不包含燃气联合循环机组；欧美日超超临界机组后期略高于美国1980年代水平，但仍远低于55%–60%。

coverage: 西门子德国伊尔申（Irsching）联合循环电厂2011年5月60.75%净热效率世界纪录
excerpt: 2011年5月西门子在德国巴伐利亚Irsching电厂试运行中实现60.75%净效率，首次突破60%目标门槛，上一代机组效率为58.5%。
limitation: 该数值为特定测试运行条件下的世界纪录净效率（LHV口径），且实现时间比贝尔转引的“1980年前后”晚了约30年。

coverage: 磁流体发电（MHD）示范测试与商用化进展综述
excerpt: 商用燃煤磁流体（MHD）发电设计缺乏足够可靠性记录，始终未实现大型商用电厂投运；美国能源部1980年代启动的多年项目仅在1992年完成了50 MW示范燃烧器测试。
limitation: 维基百科为二次综合条目且无单一发表日期元数据，仅用于佐证MHD未在1980年前后或之后实现大型商用电力投运。

coverage: 美国能源部（DOE）/ ONSITE SYCOM 1999年热电联产（CHP）与燃料电池商用化评估报告
excerpt: 燃料电池商用开发始于1970年代，至1999年仅磷酸燃料电池（PAFC）实现商用，纯发电效率40%–60%（LHV）；另指出热电联产（CHP）综合能源利用效率可超90%，而美国集中式纯发电平均输送效率低于33%。
limitation: 报告发布于1999年10月；其中超90%效率指热电联产（电力+余热回收）的综合能源利用率，不同于火电厂纯发电热效率。

coverage: GE HA级燃气联合循环电厂2016年（62.22%净效率）与2018年（63.08%毛效率）吉尼斯世界纪录
excerpt: 吉尼斯世界纪录认证GE 9HA机组在法国Bouchain电厂于2016年6月实现62.22%净效率，GE 7HA机组在日本中部电力西名古屋电厂于2018年3月实现63.08%毛效率。
limitation: 分别采用净效率（Bouchain）与毛效率（Nishi-Nagoya）口径，反映全球顶尖联合循环机组的效率上限而非行业平均水平。

coverage: 英国SSE Keadby-2电厂西门子能源SGT5-9000HL机组2024年5月64.2%联合循环效率世界纪录
excerpt: 2024年5月经吉尼斯世界纪录认证，英国Keadby-2联合循环电厂（装机近850 MW）创下64.2%的联合循环效率世界纪录。
limitation: 为截至2024年5月全球最高联合循环发电效率单厂纪录（LHV口径），反映1980年后四十余年火电发电效率上限仍远低于90%。

coverage: 美国能源信息署（EIA）《电力年报》表8.1：2015–2025年美国各类火电与核电机组平均运行热耗率
excerpt: 2015至2025年，美国燃煤机组平均运行热耗率维持在10,465–10,777 Btu/kWh（2025年10,647，折合热效率约32.0%），天然气机组为7,689–7,869 Btu/kWh（2025年7,781，折合热效率约43.9%）。
limitation: 该表为美国全网各类火电机组的平均运行热耗率（HHV口径），低于新建H/J级联合循环机组的单厂最高效率，用于展示行业整体效率已长期平台化。

coverage: 1870-1998年21个国家19项主要技术的跨国扩散与资本品采纳时滞实证研究（NBER Working Paper w12314，Diego Comin & Bart Hobijn）。
excerpt: Estimation of our model for a sample of 19 technologies, 21 countries, and the period 1870-1998 reveals that embodied productivity growth is large for many of the technologies in our sample. On average, increases in the variety of vintages available is a more important source of growth than the increases in the embodiment margin. There is, however, substantial heterogeneity across technologies.
limitation: 属于跨国长期宏观技术扩散模型与摘要，未逐项列举1970-1975年美国全部商业创新清单，仅提供技术采纳时滞与跨技术异质性的宏观背景支持。

coverage: 计算机历史博物馆（CHM）《硅引擎》关于1971年单片微处理器（Intel 4004）及1974年第二代8位微处理器（Intel 8080、Motorola 6800）商业化与广泛接受的历史记录。
excerpt: In 1971, Federico Faggin, assisted by Masatoshi Shima, applied his experience in silicon-gate MOS technology (1968 Milestone) to squeeze the 2300 transistors of the 4004 into a low-cost 16-pin package.
limitation: 页面未标明原始发表日期（仅可确认在截止日前可公开获取），且侧重半导体产业史，未量化1970-1975年微处理器对美国总体GDP的占比。

coverage: 1979年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖得主Godfrey N. Hounsfield官方自传，记录CT扫描仪（EMI-Scanner）于1967年首次萌生构想并在1971-1976年间完成临床原型与商业化投产的时间线。
excerpt: One of the suggestions I put forward was connected with automatic pattern recognition and it was while exploring various aspects of pattern recognition and their potential, in 1967, that the idea occurred to me which was eventually to become the EMI-Scanner and the technique of computed tomography.
limitation: 属于发明人自传体历史记录，聚焦英国EMI实验室研发与早期临床/投产节点，未直接给出1970-1975年美国医院装机总量统计。

coverage: NBER Working Paper w29484（Michael Kremer, Jack Willis & Yang You，《Converging to Convergence》），检验1960年代以来及1990/2000年后25年全球跨国无条件经济增长趋同趋势。
excerpt: We revisit these findings, using the subsequent 25 years as an out-of-sample test, and document a trend towards unconditional convergence since 1990 and convergence since 2000, driven by both faster catch-up growth and slower growth of the frontier.
limitation: 衡量对象主要为人均收入的β趋同（穷国追赶富国），并不直接等同于所有国家经济增长率在数值上已完全拉平；且1960-1990年代并未出现无条件趋同。

coverage: NBER Working Paper w19010（Diego Comin & Marti Mestieri，《If Technology Has Arrived Everywhere, Why has Income Diverged?》），检验近两百年技术跨国采纳时滞与渗透率分化对跨国收入发散的解释力。
excerpt: Using data from the last two centuries, we document two new facts: there has been convergence in adoption lags between rich and poor countries, while there has been divergence in penetration rates. Using a model of adoption and growth, we show that these changes in the pattern of technology diffusion account for 80% of the Great Income Divergence between rich and poor countries since 1820.
limitation: 样本跨度为近两百年历史技术扩散，聚焦技术到达时滞与渗透率的双维度分化及其对收入差距的长期解释，未单独报告2013年之后的最新数据。

coverage: 世界银行WDI官方接口（NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG）1973-2024年美国、世界及主要区域实际GDP年均增长率分阶段统计。
excerpt: 2010-2024: United States (USA): 2.42%; Europe & Central Asia (ECS): 1.77%; East Asia & Pacific (EAS): 4.60%; South Asia (SAS): 6.04%; Latin America & Caribbean (LCN): 1.90%; Sub-Saharan Africa (SSF): 3.10%; World (WLD): 2.98%.
limitation: 以世界银行区域汇总及美国实际GDP年均增长率作为跨国增长率是否趋于拉平的宏观代理，未单列单一小国异常波动，且区域均值可能平滑区域内部差异。

coverage: 1953-2023 美国全社会研发支出占GDP比重（按基础研究、应用研究、试验发展分项）
excerpt: 美国R&D占GDP比重从1973年的2.17%升至2022年的3.43%（2023年估测3.39%），突破1964年2.79%的历史前高，主要由试验发展驱动。
limitation: 衡量的是美国宏观R&D投入强度而非直接统计全部创新产出中源自R&D的精确占比；2022年部分数据为初值，2023年为估测值。

coverage: 2017-2024 美国与全球科学与工程产出、高研发行业新产品引入率、TFP增长及KTI产业增加值占GDP比重
excerpt: 2022年软件出版等高研发信息行业新产品/服务引入率达54%，导航测量等高研发制造业达46%，远高于全行业23%；2017-2024年高研发信息部门TFP增长13%高于非农整体8%；2024年美国KTI产业增加值3.3万亿美元，占GDP的11%。
limitation: KTI仅涵盖OECD口径下的高及中高研发强度产业，窄于贝尔与马克卢普的广义“知识领域”；高研发行业创新率对比为2022年截面数据。

coverage: 2016-2022 美国雇主企业创新率及2020-2022年各类创新活动（含研发与非研发活动）参与比例
excerpt: 2020-2022年报告创新的美国企业中，仅25%开展R&D活动，低于员工知识技能培训（41%）、机器设备购置（34%）及营销品牌建设（33%）；全行业总体创新率由2016-2018年的30%降至2020-2022年的23%。
limitation: ABS为2016年以后的企业抽样调查，缺少1973年以来的长序列对比，且按企业数量等权统计而非按经济增加值加权。

coverage: 1958-2000 美国知识/信息经济占GNP比重（衔接Machlup 1958与Porat 1967至1997）及信息从业人员占总就业比重
excerpt: 沿用Porat与Rubin方法测算，1997年美国第一与第二信息部门合计贡献GNP的63%（较Machlup测算1958年29%持续上升）；据Wolff(2006)人口普查数据，美国信息工人占劳动力比重从1950年的37%升至2000年的59%（作者1999年口径为54%），但按岗位数量计最大单一门类仍为服务业中的非信息体力岗位。
limitation: 数据截至1997-2000年，未覆盖2000年代以后的数字经济新发展，且Machlup与Porat口径存在一定统计差异。

coverage: 1980-2015 美国高教育/培训/经验要求职业与低要求职业的就业人数及增速对比
excerpt: 1980至2015年，要求中等至高于平均水平教育、培训和经验的职业就业人数从4900万增至8300万（增幅68%），是低要求职业增幅（从5000万增至6500万，增幅31%）的两倍以上，其在总就业中的占比显著上升。
limitation: 以教育与技能准备度代理“知识领域就业”，观察期覆盖1980-2015年，未包含2016年之后的变化。

coverage: 1980-2005 美国劳动力市场就业与工资极化及低技能服务业岗位扩张
excerpt: 1980至2005年间美国出现就业与工资极化：信息技术自动化替代常规中等技能岗位后，低技能劳动力向低技能服务业岗位再配置，与高技能知识岗位扩张并行。
limitation: 观察期为1980-2005年，说明服务业内部存在高低技能分化，但不直接否定高技能知识职业占比上升。

coverage: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), Handbook of Labor Statistics, Bulletin 2175 (December 1983), Table 16 (Employed civilians by occupation, 1958-82) and Table 17 (Employed civilians by detailed occupation, 1975-82), CPS annual averages (in thousands).
excerpt: Table 16 reports U.S. employed civilians in Professional and technical occupations at 8,542 thousand in 1964, 12,934 thousand in 1975 (+51.4%), and 13,550 thousand in 1976; Table 17 reports 549 thousand college/university teachers and 3,049 thousand teachers except college/university (3,598 thousand total, 27.8% of 12,934 thousand) in 1975.
limitation: 该序列基于美国当前人口调查（CPS）并在1980年人口普查基准上做了历史修订，测度的是实际就业人数而非贝尔原文所称的“人力需求”；此外，CPS职业口径下非高校教师含学前/成人及其他教师，较NCES课堂教师口径更宽。

coverage: U.S. Department of Labor & U.S. Department of Health, Education, and Welfare, Employment and Training Report of the President, 1976, Table A-15 (Employed Persons 16 Years and Over, by Occupation Group and Sex: Annual Averages, 1958-75).
excerpt: Table A-15 (contemporaneous unrevised CPS series published in 1976) reports Professional and technical employment at 8,542 thousand in 1964 and 12,748 thousand in 1975 (+49.2%), during the 1975 recession when total civilian employment fell from 85,936 thousand in 1974 to 84,783 thousand in 1975.
limitation: 该表为1976年当年发布的未修订CPS口径（尚未按1980年人口普查权重回溯调整），因此1975年数值（12,748千人）略低于BLS 1983年修订后的12,934千人；同时1975年恰逢美国经济衰退期。

coverage: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics (NCES), Digest of Education Statistics 2022, Table 208.20: Public and private elementary and secondary teachers, fall 1955 through fall 2031 (in thousands).
excerpt: NCES Table 208.20 reports public and private elementary and secondary teachers (in thousands) rose from 1,933 in fall 1965 (1,710 public, 223 private) to 2,292 in fall 1970 and 2,453 in fall 1975 (2,198 public, 255 private), an increase of 26.9%.
limitation: 该表仅统计中小学（elementary and secondary）全职等效教师，不含高校教师，且为秋季时点数（1965年秋与1975年秋），未逐年列出1974年秋数据。

coverage: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics (NCES), Digest of Education Statistics 2017, Table 105.40: Number of teachers in elementary and secondary schools, and faculty in degree-granting postsecondary institutions, fall 1970 through fall 2027 (in thousands).
excerpt: NCES Table 105.40 reports combined elementary/secondary teachers and degree-granting postsecondary faculty rose from 2,766 thousand in fall 1970 (2,292 elem/sec + 474 postsecondary) to 3,081 thousand in fall 1975 (2,453 elem/sec + 628 postsecondary).
limitation: 该表序列自1970年秋开始，未提供1965年高校教师基数，但与贝尔原文1970年280万基数高度吻合，可直接核验1975年总规模约300万的目标。

coverage: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）《劳工统计手册》（Bulletin 2175）Table 17：1975—1982年按细分职业划分的平民就业人数（千人，含专业技术人员、工程师、工程与科学技术人员及制图员、测量员）
excerpt: Table 17. Employed civilians by detailed occupation, 1975-82 [In thousands]: Total 85,846 (1975); Professional and technical 12,934 (1975); Engineers 1,170 (1975), 1,214 (1976), 1,537 (1981); Engineering and science technicians 913 (1975), 917 (1976), 1,069 (1979), including Drafters 307 (1975) and Surveyors 72 (1975).
limitation: 该表采用1980年人口普查基准修订后的CPS口径，且“Engineering and science technicians”大类包含制图员（Drafters）和测量员（Surveyors），需扣除该两项分列数方对应贝尔原文的狭义口径；序列始于1975年，未直接列示1964年或1966年基数。

coverage: 美国总统就业与培训报告（Employment and Training Report of the President, 1976，劳工部/BLS编制）统计附录 Table A-33：1972—1975年按细分职业划分的就业人数（千人）
excerpt: Table A-33. Employment Data for Detailed Occupations, 1972-75 [Thousands]: Professional and technical 12,748 (1975); Engineers 1,150 (1975), 1,168 (1974), 1,094 (1973), 1,102 (1972); Engineering and science technicians 896 (1975), including Drafters 301 and Surveyors 70.
limitation: 该表为1976年同期发布的1970年人口普查加权CPS数据，与1983年修订序列存在小幅人口基准差异；同样将制图员与测量员计入“Engineering and science technicians”大类并分列细项，且未覆盖1964—1971年。

coverage: 美国国家科学基金会（NSF）《美国科技传播指标图表集》（1977年12月）Figure 4：1975年美国科学家与工程师总数及工程师人数估计
excerpt: In 1975, there were just over 2 million scientists and engineers in the United States. Slightly more than half (1.1 million) are engineers.
limitation: NSF口径仅提供四舍五入至十万级的汇总估计（约110万名工程师），未单列全体专业与技术人员总数分母或工程与科学技术人员数据。

coverage: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）《职业预测与培训数据》（Bulletin 2020，1979年4月）第1章及附录 Table B-1：1976年实际估计就业人数与1985年预测值（将工程与科学技术人员与制图员、测量员分列）
excerpt: Table B-1. Employment, 1976 and 1985 (Projected): Professional and technical workers 13.3 million in 1976; Engineers 1,133,000 (1976) and 1,415,000 (projected 1985); Other scientific and technical occupations in 1976: Engineering and science technicians 586,000 (projected 1985: 760,000), Drafters 320,000, Surveyors 52,000.
limitation: 基准年为1976年（晚于预测终点1975年1年），且采用BLS职业展望/行业-职业矩阵估计口径，与CPS住户调查口径存在小幅差异。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要2023》表103.20：美国18—19岁人口总在校率（中学与高等教育合计），1940—2022年年度实绩
limitation: 与贝尔原文引用的《教育统计摘要》完全同源，但该表制备于2023年6月，观察期仅覆盖至2022年10月；且18—19岁总在校率同时包含中学在校生与高等教育在校生。

coverage: 美国人口普查局当前人口调查（CPS）历史时间序列A-2表：1947年10月至2024年10月美国18—19岁非机构化平民人口在校率
limitation: 该Excel数据表未在正文元数据中注明具体发布日期，仅标明覆盖1947年10月至2024年10月；统计对象为非机构化平民人口，不含现役军人。

coverage: 美国国家科学基金会（NSF/NCSES）2023年博士学位获得者调查（SDR，NSF 25-321）表1-1与表42：在美居住的经济学与社会学（含人口学与人口研究）博士存量及就业职业分布（2023年实绩）
excerpt: Table 1-1 (U.S. residing doctoral scientists and engineers, by fine field of doctorate and employment status: 2023): Economics total 32,600 (SE 500), employed 27,950 (SE 550); Sociology, demography, and population studies total 19,200 (SE 350), employed 15,950 (SE 375).
limitation: SDR仅覆盖在美国获得研究型博士学位且居住在美国的群体，不含硕士及学士层面的经济学家或社会学家，且社会学分类合并了人口学与人口研究；NSF原1968年全国科技人员登记册已于1970年后停办，故不存在1968至2023年完全同口径连续存量序列。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要2022》表325.92：1949-50至2020-21学年美国高校授予的经济学与社会学学士、硕士及博士学位年度数量
excerpt: Economics degrees conferred: 1972-73 Bachelor's 14,770, Master's 2,225, Doctor's 845; 2020-21 Bachelor's 34,636, Master's 4,779, Doctor's 1,245. Sociology degrees conferred: 1972-73 Bachelor's 35,436, Master's 1,923, Doctor's 583; 2020-21 Bachelor's 26,291, Master's 1,283, Doctor's 573.
limitation: 该表统计的是年度学位授予增量而非在职从业者存量，观察期截至2020-21学年；年度增量虽能反映学科人才培养供给变化，但即使年度博士授予量维持在500至700人左右，长期累积仍会推高在世博士存量。

coverage: 美国国家科学基金会（NSF/NCSES）2023年获授博士学位调查（SED，NSF 24-336）表1-3与表1-7：1993—2023年及2013—2023年美国经济学与社会学研究型博士年度授予量变化
excerpt: Table 1-7 (Research doctorate recipients, 2013-23): Economics increased 9.0% from 1,183 in 2013 to 1,290 in 2023; Sociology, demography, and population studies declined 5.4% from 663 in 2013 (peak 762 in 2015) to 627 in 2023.
limitation: 仅统计美国高校年度授予的研究型博士增量（含临时签证持有者；其中2013—2023年美国公民与永久居民社会学博士由535降至494，降幅7.7%），不含硕士层级从业人员。

coverage: U.S. STEM workforce size, 2011-2021 growth, 2019-2021 employment resilience, and 2021 median earnings premium (NSF Science and Engineering Indicators 2024, NSB-2024-5, based on ACS 2011-2021).
excerpt: The science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) workforce (36.8 million workers) accounted for 24% of U.S. workers in 2021. Between 2011 and 2021, the percentage of workers in STEM occupations increased from 22% to 24%. Between 2019 and 2021, employment rates for people associated with STEM occupations decreased less (from 88% to 86%) than for people associated with non-STEM occupations (from 83% to 79%). Full-time, year-round workers in STEM occupations in 2021 had median earnings about $19,100 per year more than those in non-STEM occupations.
limitation: Covers U.S. STEM occupations (including middle-skill STW workers) rather than all professional/technical occupations globally, and primary ACS observation window ends in 2021.

coverage: Employment outcomes, out-of-field rates, and involuntary out-of-field rates for recent U.S. S&E and S&E-related degree recipients (2015-2021 cohorts as of February 2021, NSCG 2021).
excerpt: Based on self-reported data on the relationship between a respondent’s job and their highest degree, 24% of recent S&E bachelor’s degree recipients worked out of field. Larger percentages of recent bachelor’s degree graduates with majors in social sciences (37%), biological, agricultural, and environmental life sciences (32%), and physical sciences majors (22%) worked out of field than those who majored in computer and mathematical sciences (7%), S&E-related fields (9%) and engineering fields (11%) in 2021.
limitation: Snapshot as of February 2021 (during COVID-19 recovery) covering 2015-2021 U.S. degree cohorts only; self-reported job-to-degree alignment includes both voluntary career shifts and involuntary unavailability.

coverage: U.S. 1970 Census experienced civilian labor force baseline and 1970-1972 employment/unemployment changes for Engineers, Mathematical specialists, Operations researchers, Physical scientists (Chemists), and Technicians.
excerpt: Table 1 (1970 experienced civilian labor force): Engineers 1,242,518 (98.1% employed); Mathematical specialists 61,680 (Actuaries and statisticians 27,912; Mathematicians and mathematics teachers 33,768); Operations and systems researchers and analysts 80,868; Physical scientists 196,351 (Chemists and chemistry teachers 125,417; Physicists and physics teachers 36,208).
limitation: 1970 Census occupational groupings include college/university teachers within Chemists and chemistry teachers and Mathematicians and mathematics teachers (excluding teachers below college level), creating a slight classification boundary difference relative to modern ACS/SOC codes.

coverage: Detailed U.S. occupational employment counts in 2021 (ACS) for Engineers, Mathematical science occupations, and Chemists and materials scientists (NSF Science and Engineering Indicators 2024, Supplemental Table SLBR-1).
excerpt: Table SLBR-1 (2021 ACS employed adults): Architecture and engineering occupations 3,515,596 (S&E engineers codes 1320-1530 subtotal 2,494,772 plus Sales engineers 55,388); Mathematical science occupations total 547,210 (Actuaries 37,365; Operations research analysts 171,515; Other mathematical science occupations 338,330); Chemists and materials scientists (code 1720) 100,445.
limitation: 2021 ACS classification places postsecondary chemistry and mathematics teachers in postsecondary teacher codes rather than under Chemists and materials scientists (1720) or Other mathematical science occupations (1240), and groups mathematicians with statisticians and data scientists in code 1240.

coverage: U.S. STEM degree growth (2010-2018), domestic vs. foreign-born doctorate pipeline in computing and engineering (2017-2018), and OPT STEM talent inflows (2004-2016).
excerpt: Between 2010 and 2018, the most recent year for which data is available, the number of STEM bachelor’s degrees awarded grew by 62%, compared with 20% growth for all degrees. This group earned fewer than half of research doctorates in computer and information sciences (41%) and engineering and architecture (42%) in the 2017-2018 school year, the most recent year data is available.
limitation: Covers U.S. higher-education STEM degree pipeline through 2017-2018 and OPT stays through 2016; reflects supply/pipeline dynamics rather than direct job vacancy counts.

coverage: 美国高等教育机构按学科授予的学士学位数（1970-71 至 2021-22 学年，NCES Digest of Education Statistics Table 322.10）
limitation: 仅反映学位授予量（人才培养供给代理），不直接等同于就业岗位或社会规划部门的因果拉动；2021-22 学年数据为 NCES 暂定值（provisional data）。

coverage: 美国高等教育机构按学科授予的硕士学位数（1970-71 至 2021-22 学年，NCES Digest of Education Statistics Table 323.10）

coverage: 美国高等教育机构按学科授予的博士学位数（1970-71 至 2021-22 学年，NCES Digest of Education Statistics Table 324.10）

coverage: 美国国家科学委员会/NSF《科学与工程指标 2024：STEM 劳动力》（NSB-2024-5，观察期截至 2021 年）
excerpt: 2021 年美国 STEM 劳动力达 3,680 万人（占全部就业 24%，高于 2011 年的 22%），S&E 职业占比在十年间由 4% 升至 6%，全美在职美国培养 SEH 研究博士达 872,100 人；但反面边界显示，生物/农业/环境生命科学和社会科学学士学位持有者中超过 12% 处于非自愿跨专业就业状态（involuntarily working out of field）。
limitation: 核心就业趋势集中于 2011–2021 年而非从 1973 年起的连续同口径序列，且 STEM/S&E 广义口径涵盖工程、计算机等多学科，不能单列“社会规划”因果归因。

coverage: 美国国家科学委员会/NSF《科学与工程指标 2024：研发趋势与国际比较》（NSB-2024-6，观察期 1953–2022 年）
excerpt: 美国研发支出自 1953 年以来按不变美元计算保持 4% 的长期年均复合增长率，2022 年名义研发总额达 8,856 亿美元（研发强度 3.4%）；但边界显示，2022 年 78%（6,927 亿美元）的研发由私营企业部门执行，高校研发按不变美元停滞（-0.4%），联邦政府直接执行仅占 8%。
limitation: 直接度量的是研发支出规模与执行部门结构，需与劳动力数据（NSB-2024-5）结合才能对应研发对专业与技术专家的需求。

coverage: 美国中小学教师与高等教育机构教职人数统计（1970 年秋季至 2021 年秋季实绩，NCES Table 105.40）
excerpt: 美国中小学教师总数从 1970 年秋季的 229.2 万人增至 2021 年秋季的 369.8 万人（+61.3%），高校教职人员从 47.4 万人增至 149.9 万人（+216.2%），大中小学教师与教职合计从 1970 年的 276.6 万人增至 2020 年的 513.6 万人。
limitation: 表中 2022 年及以后为预测值，本评估仅采用 1970–2021 年实绩数据；总量增长不排除 1970 年代阶段性教师过剩或局部学科短缺。

coverage: 美国国家科学基金会（NSF/NCSES）《美国大学博士学位获得者调查（SED）》，1958—1980年美国高校授予研究型博士总数及科学与工程（S&E）博士数
limitation: 该表统计研究型博士（research doctorates）年授予数，不含第一专业学位（如MD、JD），且页面未标明精确发表日。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要2022》表316.10，1970-71至1980-81学年美国高校全日制教学人员9个月合同平均实际薪资（按2021-22年不变美元计）
limitation: 仅覆盖9个月合同的全日制教学人员薪资，不含兼职教师与非教学科研人员，且反映的是实际薪酬紧缩而非雇佣总人数变化。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要2022》表301.20，1959-60、1969-70与1979-80学年美国授予学位高校数量、教师总人数与秋季总在校生人数
limitation: Total faculty为包含兼职在内的不同个体总数（未折合全职当量FTE），且1969-70与1979-80学年数值为NCES基于师生比推算的估计值。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要1996》表14（源自美国人口普查局Current Population Reports, Series P-25），1960年与1980年7月1日美国18—19岁及20—21岁常住人口估计数
limitation: 1996年版表格时间跨度仅至1995年，不包含2000年数据，且为美国常住人口（不含海外驻军）口径，需与涵盖2000年的2022年版表格衔接使用。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要2022》表101.10（源自美国人口普查局），1970、1980、1990与2000年美国18—19岁及20—21岁常住人口估计数
limitation: 该表起始年份为1970年，不包含1960年基期数据，需与1996年版表14合并核验1960—1980年增量；1980年数值两表完全一致（8,718千人与8,669千人）。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要》表302.10：1960至2021年美国应届高中毕业生总数与立即升入大学的比例
limitation: 统计对象为16-24岁应届高中毕业生（含GED）当年10月的立即升学率，不包含延迟入学人群；未按职业阶层细分。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要》表302.30：1975至2016年按家庭收入分档（低/中/高收入）的应届高中毕业生立即升入大学比例
limitation: 该序列始于1975年而非1973年，且采用家庭收入最低20%作为低收入口径（回顾性代理工人阶级家庭），不包含2016年之后数据。

coverage: 皮尤研究中心（Pew Research Center）基于NCES数据发布的美国低收入家庭本科生规模、占比及院校分布研究（1995-96至2015-16学年）
excerpt: The overall number of undergraduates at U.S. colleges and universities has increased dramatically over the past 20 years, with growth fueled almost exclusively by an influx of students from low-income families and students of color.
limitation: 报告覆盖1996至2016年区间并以家庭收入与贫困线之比衡量经济背景，而非严格按蓝领/白领职业界定工人阶级；同时揭示低收入生源增长高度集中于社区学院和非选择性院校。

coverage: 美国人口普查局（U.S. Census Bureau）1900年7月1日至1999年7月1日历史全国人口年度估计表

coverage: 美国人口普查局（U.S. Census Bureau）1910至2020年历次十年人口普查美国常住人口历史变化表

coverage: 皮尤研究中心基于美国人口普查局数据对1965年以来现代移民潮与美国人口增长驱动力的分析

limitation: 核心占比统计窗口为1965-2015年而非精确的1973-2000年，但仍明确说明1970-2000年美国移民人口急剧增长并构成总人口增长的重要驱动力。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要》表303.10：1947年至2021年美国授予学位高校秋季在校生总人数（含全日制与非全日制）。
limitation: 该表统计的是授予学位高等教育机构的秋季注册人数（headcount），不区分学习质量或学位完成率，且早期1947年前数据未列于本表。

coverage: 美国人口普查局（U.S. Census Bureau）2000年人口普查简报 C2KBR-24《Educational Attainment: 2000》：截至2000年4月1日美国25岁及以上人口受教育程度分布。
excerpt: More than half the U.S. population 25 and over in 2000 (52 percent) had completed at least some college education (Table 1). Just under one quarter (24 percent) had a bachelor’s degree or more.

coverage: 美国人口普查局（U.S. Census Bureau）2000年人口普查简报 C2KBR-25《Occupations: 2000》：截至2000年4月1日美国16岁及以上在职平民的六大职业大类结构。
excerpt: At the least-detailed summary level, the highest proportion of civilian workers 16 and older, 33.6 percent, were in management, professional, and related occupations, followed by 26.7 percent in sales and office occupations.

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要》表301.20：1869-70至2020-21学年美国授予学位高校教职人员总数与在校生历史汇总。
limitation: 该表按不重复自然人总数（headcount，未折算为全日制当量FTE）统计，且1959-60年起口径为学年第一学期，与更早年度存在细微统计口径调整。

coverage: 美国国家教育统计中心（NCES）《教育统计摘要》表315.10：1970年秋至2021年秋美国授予学位高校教职人员按全职/兼职分类的历年人数。
limitation: IPEDS教职员工调查在2000年前后采用奇数年双年采集机制，未单独公布2000年秋季数据，需以1999年秋与2001年秋夹逼2000年、并以2003年秋对应1973年出版后30年节点。

coverage: 美国高校研究型博士学位（Ph.D.及同等研究型博士）年度授予量历史序列，1958—2022年（NSF/NCSES Survey of Earned Doctorates，NSF 24-300 及附表 nsf24300-fig001.xlsx）
excerpt: The number of research doctoral degrees awarded by U.S. institutions increased from 52,194 in 2021 to 57,596 in 2022, according to the Survey of Earned Doctorates (SED). coverage: 美国2000年人口普查25岁及以上人口受教育程度与博士学位持有者占比（U.S. Census Bureau, Census 2000 Brief C2KBR-24, Educational Attainment: 2000）
excerpt: Of the 182.2 million people aged 25 and over on April 1, 2000, 80 percent had a high school diploma or more, and 24 percent had completed at least a bachelor’s degree. Note: Doctoral degrees include PhD and EdD degrees.
limitation: Census 2000 Brief 仅公布博士学位占比（1.0%，按1.822亿25岁及以上人口折算约182万人）且同时包含PhD与EdD（已与MD、JD等Professional degree区分）；未单独给出不含EdD的纯Ph.D.精确人数，且发表日期仅精确至2003年8月。

coverage: 美国人口普查局CPS 2000—2018年25岁及以上博士学位持有者存量变化对比（U.S. Census Bureau America Counts, February 21, 2019）
excerpt: Since 2000, the number of people age 25 and over whose highest degree was a master’s has doubled to 21 million. The number of doctoral degree holders has more than doubled to 4.5 million.
limitation: 该文采用当前人口调查（CPS ASEC）口径对比2000年与2018年，给出2018年博士持有者450万人且“自2000年以来翻了一倍以上”（对应2000年约200万人），未在正文中直接列明2000年精确千位数。

coverage: 美国研发体系中高等教育部门与企业部门在总研发与基础研究执行及资助中的份额结构（NSF/NSB, The State of U.S. Science and Engineering 2026, March 2026，观察实绩截至2023—2024年）
excerpt: Higher education institutions perform the greatest share (48%) of basic research, much of which is federally funded. Funding of basic research: Business 34.3, Higher education 13.8, Federal government 39.9, Nonprofit organizations 9.4, Nonfederal government 2.7.
limitation: 以美国国家研发支出与基础研究执行/资助份额作为大学在后工业社会中制度核心地位的回顾性代理，无法直接衡量文化影响力或政治合法性；报告2024年全国总研发9930亿美元为估计值，2023年9370亿美元及企业7220亿美元为实绩；发表日期仅精确至2026年3月。

coverage: 美国学术研发占全国总研发及联邦研发经费比重长期演变趋势，1953—2021年（NSF/NSB, Academic Research and Development, NSB-2023-26）

coverage: 人工智能前沿模型与高被引学术研究的产业界与学术界分工对比，2023—2024年（Stanford HAI, The 2025 AI Index Report）
